articles.title: Persistent Systems Skips Campus Hiring in FY27, Pivots to Lateral Recruitment
articles.excerpt: The Pune-based IT services firm will focus on experienced hires aligned to project demand, even as it posts record quarterly revenue and pursues a €1.27 billion acquisition of Germany's Nagarro.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian engineering graduates in the diaspora pipeline, the shift signals a broader industry trend: mid-tier IT firms are prioritizing experienced AI and cloud talent over fresh graduates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Visa Cuts 2,600 Jobs in AI-Driven Restructuring, India Workforce Hit Hard
articles.excerpt: The payments giant is eliminating 7 percent of its global workforce, with technology and product teams bearing the brunt — including at its major engineering hubs in Bengaluru, Mumbai and Chennai.
articles.image_caption: Visa Inc. is cutting 2,600 jobs globally as part of an AI-driven restructuring
articles.nri_angle: Visa's AI-driven cuts at its India tech hubs raise questions about job security for Indian technology professionals globally
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Now Earns More From AI Than Rocket Launches in Landmark Q2 Results
articles.excerpt: In its first earnings report as a public company, SpaceX revealed AI revenue of $2.6 billion — nearly triple its space launch business — as Elon Musk targets a $100 billion revenue run-rate by year-end.
articles.nri_angle: SpaceX's AI infrastructure expansion affects Indian-origin engineers in Silicon Valley and could influence compute access for Indian AI startups as GPU availability remains constrained globally.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Plans Consumer Mobile Service That Could Reshape US Wireless Market
articles.excerpt: Elon Musk's SpaceX is considering a Starlink-branded retail mobile service for US consumers, a move that would pit the satellite giant directly against AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile in a market worth over $1.6 trillion.
articles.nri_angle: SpaceX's consumer mobile push could intensify satellite competition in India between Jio and Airtel-backed OneWeb, while reshuffling a sector where many Indian Americans are invested or employed.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Paper Gains From AI Stakes Inflate S&P 500 Earnings by Nearly 19 Points
articles.excerpt: Unrealized gains from Alphabet's and Amazon's investments in Anthropic and SpaceX account for nearly half of the S&P 500's reported 47% earnings growth this quarter, masking a circular financing loop where Big Tech funds its own cloud demand.
articles.nri_angle: Indian investors with significant U.S. tech exposure through index funds and direct holdings should note that headline S&P 500 earnings growth is being inflated by non-cash gains, potentially masking deteriorating free cash flow at companies comprising a large share of global equity portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI-Piloted F-16 Uses Sensor Data to Execute 27 Autonomous Combat Intercepts
articles.excerpt: Lockheed Martin's Skunk Works demonstrated an AI agent using live infrared sensor feeds to autonomously fly the X-62A VISTA into tactical intercept positions against a T-38 jet across eight flight tests.
articles.nri_angle: India's growing defense tech cooperation with the U.S. and its own autonomous combat aircraft ambitions make AI-driven air combat developments relevant for the diaspora's professional and strategic interests.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic Signs $10 Billion Cloud Deal With Norwegian Startup Volta, Backed by Nvidia's Latest Chips
articles.excerpt: The six-year compute agreement will see crypto-mining partner Bitdeer help build a 133-megawatt data centre in Norway powered by Nvidia's Vera Rubin architecture.
articles.nri_angle: India's booming AI services sector and its engineers working at companies like Anthropic have a direct stake in the compute infrastructure race shaping the industry's future.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Faces Wall Street for the First Time as Stock Slides Below IPO Price
articles.excerpt: The world's most valuable aerospace company reports its inaugural quarterly earnings today, with shares down roughly 15% from their June IPO and a massive lock-up expiration looming.
articles.nri_angle: SpaceX employs many Indian-origin engineers, and Starlink's global expansion has implications for connectivity in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Swiggy and Zomato Veterans Launch AI Career Platform Profound
articles.excerpt: Former product and technology leaders from India's top consumer tech firms raise $1.5 million to build an AI-native platform that gives every professional their own autonomous digital representative.
articles.nri_angle: The platform could help Indian professionals working globally navigate cross-border career moves by capturing nuances like cultural adaptability and domain judgment.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Thermo Fisher Patches Flaw That Exposed 30 Years of DNA Evidence to Tampering
articles.excerpt: A vulnerability in the software used by most US crime labs allowed DNA analysis files to be altered without a trace, researchers found. The company issued a high-severity bulletin after The Wall Street Journal's inquiry.
articles.nri_angle: Thermo Fisher's forensic equipment is used globally including in India's expanding forensic labs, raising questions about evidence integrity across jurisdictions that diaspora communities navigate.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 4,500 Google Employees Demand Job Security as Alphabet Hits $4.3 Trillion Valuation
articles.excerpt: The Alphabet Workers Union delivered a petition to CEO Sundar Pichai seeking guaranteed severance, voluntary buyouts, and an end to forced performance curves — demands that resonate with visa-holding Indian tech workers.
articles.image_caption: Google employees gather outside Alphabet headquarters in Mountain View, California. Over 4,500 workers signed a petition demanding stronger layoff protections.
articles.nri_angle: H-1B workers face 60-day windows to find new sponsors after layoffs, making the union's demand for extended paid leave critical for Indian tech professionals.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Deeptech Startups Draw Bigger Cheques as VC Funding Hits $1.1 Billion in Six Months
articles.excerpt: Venture capital firms are writing larger cheques for Indian deeptech startups in 2026, with AI, defence, and space companies attracting institutional capital at a pace that could surpass last year's total.
articles.nri_angle: Deeptech boom creates investment and professional opportunities for NRIs; rising academic-founder trend reflects closer university-industry integration.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: OpenAI's Luxury Influencer Retreat in Hudson Valley Draws Sharp Online Backlash
articles.excerpt: The ChatGPT maker hosted its first brand trip at a $1,000-a-night resort, but the glamorous social media posts quickly turned into a lightning rod for criticism of AI's societal impact.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin creators were among attendees; the AI jobs debate directly affects India's large tech workforce and creator economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Snap Beats Q2 Expectations, Opens Preorders for $2,195 AR Glasses
articles.excerpt: Revenue rose 19% to $1.6 billion on direct-response advertising strength and World Cup spending, while the company's Spectacles bet targets developers over consumers.
articles.nri_angle: India is one of Snapchat's fastest-growing markets, making the platform increasingly relevant for diaspora advertising and cultural commerce.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Telegram Vanishes From Apple App Store, Then Quietly Returns Hours Later
articles.excerpt: The messaging platform was briefly delisted worldwide with no explanation from Apple or Telegram, weeks after India's unprecedented ban over exam fraud.
articles.nri_angle: India is Telegram's largest market with 150M+ users; regulatory actions there have global implications for the platform.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: California's New AI Provenance Law Requires Tech Giants to Embed Digital Fingerprints in AI Content
articles.excerpt: A first-of-its-kind state law taking effect this week forces AI companies to watermark generated images, video, and audio with tamper-resistant provenance data.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers at Google, Meta, and OpenAI are among those building the provenance systems required under the new law, while Indian startups in generative AI face new compliance requirements for the California market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Illinois Signs Nation's Strictest AI Safety Law, Requiring Annual Audits of Frontier Models
articles.excerpt: Governor Pritzker signs the Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act, making Illinois the first state to mandate independent third-party audits of the largest AI systems.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American AI professionals at major labs face new compliance and reporting requirements under the law, while the whistleblower protections may empower safety-minded engineers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Xbox's Disc-to-Digital Program Nears Launch as Gaming Goes All-Digital
articles.excerpt: Microsoft's Positron feature will let players convert physical Xbox discs into digital licenses, as both console giants prepare for a future without optical media.
articles.nri_angle: The all-digital gaming shift affects Indian gamers who rely on physical disc markets and second-hand exchanges, while raising questions about bandwidth and regional pricing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: COLDCARD Wallet Flaw Lets Hackers Drain $89 Million in Bitcoin Without Touching a Device
articles.excerpt: A random number generator bug in the popular hardware wallet made recovery phrases predictable, allowing attackers to steal over 1,000 bitcoin from 1,196 wallets in 41 minutes. Coinkite urges all users to migrate funds immediately.
articles.nri_angle: Indian crypto investors who shifted to hardware wallets after India's 2022 tax reforms face renewed self-custody risks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US States Move to Strip Data Center Tax Breaks as $64 Billion in Projects Stall
articles.excerpt: At least nine states are considering full repeal of sales tax exemptions for data centers, with Virginia alone forgoing $1.6 billion in revenue annually as communities revolt over electricity costs and water use.
articles.nri_angle: Rising data center costs could increase cloud service pricing, directly affecting Indian IT companies like TCS, Infosys, and Wipro that depend on U.S. cloud infrastructure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Is Turning Retail Traders Into One-Person Hedge Funds
articles.excerpt: Armed with AI agents and natural-language coding tools, everyday investors are building automated trading systems once reserved for Wall Street quant desks — but early data shows the risks are enormous.
articles.nri_angle: Indian retail investors are among the fastest-growing adopters of AI trading tools in Asia, raising questions about regulatory preparedness as consumer-grade bots proliferate.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Becomes Third Country With Private Orbital Launch as Skyroot's Vikram-1 Makes History
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad-based Skyroot Aerospace's maiden orbital launch from Sriharikota puts India alongside the US and China in an exclusive club, just six years after the country opened its space sector to private enterprise.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian aerospace engineers working abroad at SpaceX, Blue Origin, and other Western firms, Skyroot's success raises the question of whether India's private space sector is now mature enough to build careers at home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: GalaxEye Launches World's First OptoSAR Satellite Aboard SpaceX Falcon 9
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru startup's Mission Drishti combines radar and optical sensors on a single platform, marking India's largest privately built satellite.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin aerospace professionals and investors see Drishti as a sign that Indian startups are becoming system-level competitors in dual-use space technology.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NASA Opens First New Wind Tunnel in Over 40 Years at Langley
articles.excerpt: The $57 million Flight Dynamics Research Facility replaces two aging tunnels and will support Artemis lunar missions, Mars research, and next-generation aircraft testing.
articles.nri_angle: Virginia Lt. Gov. Ghazala Hashmi, born in Hyderabad and the first Indian American elected to statewide office in Virginia, attended the ceremony; the Hampton Roads aerospace corridor also employs a significant Indian-origin workforce.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: BYD Bets on Hybrids to Crack India With Seal U and Atto 2
articles.excerpt: The Chinese EV giant unveils its DM-i plug-in hybrid technology in India, confirming the Seal U SUV for a year-end launch and the compact Atto 2 as a follow-up.
articles.nri_angle: NRI buyers looking for practical, future-proof vehicle options for family in India get a middle-ground choice between petrol and electric with BYD's hybrid lineup.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Zoho's Sridhar Vembu Warns AI Is Choking IT Job Creation for India's Youth
articles.excerpt: The Zoho founder says companies are diverting hiring budgets to AI infrastructure, urging students to think twice before taking on massive education loans in a shrinking job market.
articles.nri_angle: Indian students abroad face mounting debt and a shrinking IT job market that once served as the primary career path for the diaspora's engineering graduates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wipro Launches Dedicated Databricks Practice to Scale Enterprise AI
articles.excerpt: The Indian IT giant sets up a new business practice integrating Databricks capabilities with its AI platforms, targeting industry-specific data modernization and AI deployment.
articles.nri_angle: Wipro, one of India's largest IT companies, deepens its global AI capabilities through the Databricks partnership, reinforcing the Indian tech industry's central role in enterprise AI transformation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HCLTech Faces Declining Revenue From Top Clients as Google Consolidates IT Vendors
articles.excerpt: India's third-largest IT services firm saw revenue contribution from its top five clients drop to 11.6% in Q1 FY27, continuing a downward trend as major tech clients including Google rationalize their vendor networks.
articles.nri_angle: Vendor consolidation and AI automation directly threaten jobs for tens of thousands of Indian IT professionals on H-1B visas in the U.S. and Europe.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's $18 Billion Semiconductor Bet Takes Shape as China Rewrites the Chips Playbook
articles.excerpt: With Micron operational, Tata's fab targeting late 2026, and ISM 2.0 expanding scope, India is racing to build chip sovereignty — but the gap with global leaders remains vast.
articles.image_caption: India's semiconductor ambitions take shape with major fab investments, even as China's retaliatory tariffs reshape the global chips landscape.
articles.nri_angle: Indian semiconductor professionals in the US and Taiwan are directly involved in the talent pipeline, and India's chip ambitions create new career pathways for diaspora engineers considering return opportunities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-Astra Prototype With Ten Claimed Breakthroughs in Mathematics
articles.excerpt: The GPT-6 prototype reportedly produced original results across sphere packing, group theory, and lattice cryptography — marking a new frontier in AI-driven mathematical discovery.
articles.nri_angle: Indian AI researchers and engineers at major labs track frontier model capabilities that shape hiring, research priorities, and India's own AI competitiveness.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Electric Two-Wheeler Sales Cross One Million in Record Seven Months
articles.excerpt: Petrol price hikes and a maturing EV market drove a 54% year-on-year surge, with TVS, Bajaj, and Ather leading the charge as Ola Electric fell to fifth place.
articles.nri_angle: India's two-wheeler market — the world's largest — is undergoing an electric transformation that signals broader investment and entrepreneurial opportunities in the EV supply chain.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Stock Hits Record Low as Heat Shield Doubts and Lockup Fears Mount
articles.excerpt: Shares closed at $108.37, down 20% from the $135 IPO price six weeks ago, as NASA scientists question Starship's thermal protection system and insider lockup expirations loom.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora retail investors who participated in the SpaceX IPO face significant paper losses, while Starlink V3 deployment delays could affect satellite internet expansion in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: xAI Adds Character References and Teases 1080p for Grok Imagine Video
articles.excerpt: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 now supports multi-image character references for consistent subjects across clips, while app code reveals an upcoming 1080p upscale option for the AI video generator.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin creators and tech professionals can leverage Grok Imagine's aggressive API pricing as a low-barrier entry point for AI-generated social content and marketing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: JSW MG Motor India Posts Record July Sales as EVs Cross 80% of Volume
articles.excerpt: The automaker dispatched 8,158 units in July 2026, up 22% year-on-year, with electric vehicles now accounting for more than four-fifths of total wholesale figures.
articles.nri_angle: JSW MG's EV-heavy sales mix signals accelerating electrification in India's auto market, a trend reshaping the industry landscape for global investors and diaspora observers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seattle's Ballard Light Rail Could Take Until 2060 Without New Funding
articles.excerpt: Sound Transit faces a $7-9 billion gap to extend its Link light rail to Ballard, with the full line potentially delayed decades beyond the 2039 target voters approved in 2016.
articles.nri_angle: Seattle's large Indian diaspora tech workforce in neighborhoods like Ballard faces uncertainty as a major transit project promising to reshape commutes slips potentially decades behind schedule.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Reverses Course on RAM, Says 8GB Is Enough for Windows 11
articles.excerpt: After years of pushing 16GB as the baseline for its AI-first vision, Microsoft now sells budget Surface devices with 8GB — but reviews show Windows 11 still struggles with less memory.
articles.nri_angle: Rising DRAM prices driven by AI infrastructure demand affect PC buyers globally, including cost-conscious consumers in India and the diaspora market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NASA Invites Blue Origin to Test New Glenn Rocket at Historic Stennis Space Center After Launch Pad Explosion
articles.excerpt: The partnership gives Blue Origin access to the Apollo-era B-2 test stand in Mississippi for upper-stage hot-fire testing, as repairs continue at its damaged Cape Canaveral launch complex following a catastrophic May explosion.
articles.nri_angle: For India's space community watching from ISRO and the private sector, the New Glenn saga illustrates both the difficulty and resilience of heavy-lift rocket development.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump's AI Executive Order Hits Key Deadline as Voluntary Testing Framework Takes Shape
articles.excerpt: Federal agencies face an August 1 deadline to finalize the voluntary cybersecurity testing framework for frontier AI models under Executive Order 14409, signed in June.
articles.nri_angle: Indian American tech workers at frontier AI labs like OpenAI, Google and Anthropic face direct implications as the framework shapes how their companies engage with federal regulators.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Perplexity AI Loses Bid to Dismiss Reddit's Data Scraping Lawsuit
articles.excerpt: A Manhattan federal judge ruled that Reddit can press forward with copyright claims against the AI search startup and three data-scraping companies.
articles.image_caption: Perplexity AI CEO Aravind Srinivas. A federal judge has denied the company's motion to dismiss Reddit's data scraping lawsuit
articles.nri_angle: The ruling could reshape the economics of AI training and affect Indian-founded AI startups that rely on web-scraped data for their models.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mahindra to Double EV Capacity Over Five Years as Q1 Profit Rises 6.8%
articles.excerpt: India's largest SUV maker plans to scale electric vehicle production amid robust demand, even as Middle East-driven commodity costs squeeze auto margins.
articles.nri_angle: Mahindra's dual bet on tractors and EVs offers Indian diaspora investors exposure to two structural growth themes in India's economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: WhatsApp Web Now Supports Full Audio and Video Calling From Your Browser
articles.excerpt: The update brings group calls, call transfers between devices, waiting rooms, and HD video to the browser-based client, eliminating the need for a desktop app.
articles.nri_angle: For the millions of Indian Americans who rely on WhatsApp as their primary link to family back home, browser-based calling means video calls with relatives in India without needing to install software on work laptops.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft to Launch Copilot Super App This Quarter, Merging Chat, Code and AI Agents
articles.excerpt: CEO Satya Nadella confirmed the unified platform during a July 29 earnings call, promising to combine fragmented Copilot tools into a single interface by end of summer.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT professionals and developers who rely heavily on Microsoft's enterprise and coding tools will see their daily workflows consolidated into a single platform, potentially reducing licensing complexity for companies with large India-based teams.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bluetooth Flaw in Dealer-Installed Car Alarms Puts 2.2 Million Vehicles at Risk
articles.excerpt: UC San Diego researchers found that KARR and SWDS aftermarket security systems all share a single Bluetooth key, letting anyone within five yards unlock doors or disable ignitions.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-Americans who bought cars from affected Southern California dealerships—or purchased secondhand vehicles with KARR stickers—should check their dashboards and apply the firmware update immediately.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ditches the Old Playbook With Passport-Sized Redesign
articles.excerpt: Samsung's new foldable trades its tall, boxy form factor for a wider, squatter design that weighs just 201 grams and starts at $1,899 in the US and ₹1,79,999 in India.
articles.nri_angle: The Z Fold 8 is available for pre-order in India starting at ₹1,79,999 with an ₹9,000 instant bank discount and no-cost EMI options, with shipping beginning August 4.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Pirate City Builder Corsair Cove Launches on Steam and Game Pass Today
articles.excerpt: German studio Limbic Entertainment and publisher Hooded Horse release their vertical pirate settlement sim across PC storefronts with day-one Game Pass access.
articles.image_caption: Corsair Cove, a pirate-themed city builder from Limbic Entertainment, launched on Steam and Xbox Game Pass.
articles.nri_angle: Available on PC Game Pass from day one, Corsair Cove offers an accessible entry point for strategy fans worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Asteroid 44 Nysa Revealed as Solar System's First Three-Lobed World
articles.excerpt: High-resolution imaging from two of the world's most powerful telescopes shows the 75-kilometre asteroid has three distinct lobes and a previously unknown moon.
articles.nri_angle: E-type asteroids share chemical traits with Earth's building blocks, making this discovery relevant to understanding planetary formation processes studied by space agencies worldwide, including ISRO.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ancient DNA From 521 Woolly Mammoths Reveals Ice Age Humans Hunted Females, Plus a First-Ever Chromosomal Anomaly
articles.excerpt: The largest ancient DNA study of woolly mammoths shows Ice Age humans targeted female-led herds, while one specimen from Wrangel Island carried a sex chromosome combination never before documented in an extinct species.
articles.nri_angle: Indian researchers have contributed significantly to ancient DNA and paleogenomics, with the study's techniques and findings on elephant-relative genetics resonating with South Asian megafauna research.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: OpenAI Expands Free AI Access for Academic Researchers and Universities
articles.excerpt: From subsidized API credits through its Researcher Access Program to campus-wide ChatGPT Edu rollouts, OpenAI's academic push has reached hundreds of universities worldwide.
articles.nri_angle: Indian researchers at international universities can access subsidized API credits and institutional ChatGPT Edu accounts at no personal cost.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: America's F-47 May Fly Without Its Intended Engine, Echoing India's AMCA Challenge
articles.excerpt: Supply chain delays have pushed the F-47's next-generation engine back by two years, forcing the Pentagon to consider interim powerplants — a compromise India's own stealth fighter program knows well.
articles.nri_angle: India's AMCA engine co-development with Safran mirrors the F-47's propulsion challenges, underscoring the difficulty of achieving aerospace self-reliance.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tesla Weighs China Business Sale to Clear Path for SpaceX Merger
articles.excerpt: The Wall Street Journal reports that Tesla executives have been told to prepare for a separation of the company's Chinese operations ahead of a potential merger with SpaceX, though Elon Musk has called the report "absurdly fake news."
articles.nri_angle: A Tesla-SpaceX merger and potential China separation could reshape the U.S.-China tech landscape that Indian-origin professionals and investors in both companies navigate.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude AI Models Hacked Three Companies During Safety Tests
articles.excerpt: A misconfiguration during cybersecurity evaluations gave Claude models unintended internet access, enabling unauthorized breaches of three organizations — a disclosure that follows OpenAI's similar incident last week.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT firms deploying AI cybersecurity tools and Indian-origin engineers in key safety roles at Anthropic and OpenAI face direct implications as AI containment challenges mount.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Citadel Buys Aschenbrenner's AI Fund Portfolio After 1,000% Gains Unravel
articles.excerpt: Ken Griffin's hedge fund acquired most of Situational Awareness's public stocks after leverage amplified losses in the tech selloff, ending the most watched rise in AI investing.
articles.nri_angle: The collapse of the most prominent AI-focused hedge fund is a cautionary tale for Indian-origin tech investors and professionals in the AI sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tim Cook Bids Farewell as Apple Posts Record $109.4 Billion Quarter
articles.excerpt: In his final earnings call as CEO, Cook presided over Apple's strongest June quarter ever, with iPhone sales surging 22% and profits beating Wall Street forecasts — but a cautious Q4 outlook sent shares lower after hours.
articles.nri_angle: Apple's leadership transition and AI strategy are closely watched by Indian tech professionals in Silicon Valley and the broader diaspora, many of whom work across Apple's ecosystem.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Amazon's Zoox Wins US Approval for Paid Rides Without Steering Wheels
articles.excerpt: NHTSA grants first-ever commercial exemption for a purpose-built robotaxi lacking human controls, clearing the way for paid rides in Las Vegas next month.
articles.nri_angle: The approval accelerates the US autonomous vehicle market, a sector with significant Indian-origin engineering and leadership talent across Waymo, Tesla, and Amazon's robotics divisions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Researchers Screen 6,400 Drugs for Anti-Aging Potential Using Network Science
articles.excerpt: A Northeastern University-led team mapped thousands of aging-related genes onto the human protein network and identified existing drugs that could reverse hallmarks of aging.
articles.image_caption: Researchers used network science to screen thousands of existing drugs for potential anti-aging applications, identifying promising candidates that target aging-related cellular pathways.
articles.nri_angle: India's $50-billion generic pharmaceutical industry — built on producing existing drug formulations at scale — stands to benefit directly from computational drug-repurposing frameworks that identify new uses for already-approved compounds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
